text:
marta_marketing: Hey runtime — we're finalizing the launch post and need slice-level perf and token-cost artifacts to justify the "up to 3x lower cost" claim. Can you help produce:
- per-model latency CDFs for cold vs warmed for seq lengths 32/128/512
- token-cost per 1k tokens for quantized vs fp16 (same model)
- 95/99 tail and p50 for embed endpoints on 512-dim
We also need reproducible run artifacts (script, seed, input shard) and a short methodology blurb we can paste in the blog.

alex.m: +1, include expected CI-friendly CSVs. Also need warmup policy (how many tokens) used for "warmed" numbers.

sam_runtime: We can run this. Quick clarifying Qs: do you want traffic-mix weighted aggregations (typical customer) or pure synthetic distribs? Also confirm which model versions (gpt-small v1 / v1-q4) to compare.

priya: For the webinar demo we also want a small A/B sample of 20 prompts (real user prompts) and the raw outputs for quality check. Will need PII scrubbed.

marta_marketing: Use both: main table with weighted by our launch cohort (we'll attach list), and a synthetic sweep for tails. Models: gpt-small@v1 and gpt-small@v1-q4. Warmed = 1k token warmup prefix. PII scrub = yes.

sam_runtime: Got it. I'll schedule a nightly run against dedicated infra so results are stable. Deliverables:
- s3 CSVs: latency_cdf_{model}_{seq}.csv
- cost_est_{model}.csv
- methodology.md (short)
- sample_outputs.zip (20 prompts)
ETA: initial artifacts tomorrow EOD, nightly updates for 3 days. Will include run command.

alex.m: Can you paste the minimal run command here so I can include in methodology? e.g.
```
./run_perf.sh --model gpt-small@v1 --seq 128 --workers 8 --warmup_tokens 1000 --out s3://...
```

sam_runtime: Sure — using pinned runtime image and seed:
```
./run_perf.sh --model gpt-small@v1 --variant fp16 --seq 128 --workers 8 --warmup_tokens 1000 --seed 42 --out s3://redwood-launch/latency/
```
Will also attach the exact Docker image sha and commit.

ci-bot: nightly_job/launch-perf scheduled: starts 2024-06-30T02:00Z, target 3 runs.

priya: thx. For PII scrub, can you run outputs through `scripts/scrub_pii.py --minimize`? That's the canonical.

sam_runtime: Yep. Will pipe outputs through that script and include pre/post counts. I'll post links once upload completes.

marta_marketing: Amazing — please tag me when first upload lands. :rocket:
